mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% month-over-month signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise >0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100k) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 100k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals recessionary conditions that depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, quarterly GDP growth deceleration (GDPC1 growth < 1.5%) signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when quarterly GDP growth < 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
